6000m: 1.P.Fudge (Hounslow) 18.49; 2.A.Ford (Hounslow) 19.14; 3.R.Honeychurch 19.46; A very good result for Rosemary in a class field and with over 100 finishers.
She represented Surrey in the Inter-Counties C.C.Champs 1985 but her best run was to chase Ann Ford in the C.P. 6km road race at the end of December.
